TEST-SLIDE-01.senior_engineer_remarks: Detailed geotechnical field assessment of the Mandi landslide sector reveals an active slide triggered by hydrostatic pore-pressure buildup and inadequate hillside storm drainage. The adverse daylighting of joint sets (Strike N35°W, Dip 45° SW) combined with steep artificial cut geometry precipitated sudden crown detachment. Immediate clearance of 324 m³ carriageway debris followed by construction of a 18m long Plum Concrete Breast Wall (H=3.5m) and crest interceptor drainage is mandatory to secure road formation and prevent retrograde slope slumping.

plain_language_explanation.summary_title: High Landslide & Road Blockage in Mandi Sector
plain_language_explanation.what_happened: A steep section of the hillside gave way, dumping loose mud, rock fragments, and heavy boulders across the road. Fallen debris has obstructed the carriageway, creating a major hazard for commuters.
plain_language_explanation.why_it_happened: Heavy rainfall soaked deep into the mountain slope. Water filled natural cracks in the rock, making the soil heavy and slippery until the steep hillside could no longer support its own weight and slipped down.
plain_language_explanation.road_and_travel_impact: The road is severely obstructed (0.00 m (Fully Blocked Carriageway)). Vehicles cannot safely pass this point. Roadside drainage channels are filled with mud and rocks, causing water to pool on the road.
plain_language_explanation.ongoing_hazards: The hillside directly above remains unstable. Any additional rain, wind, or ground vibration can dislodge more loose rocks. Sagging overhead cables or rolling stones pose an immediate danger.
plain_language_explanation.what_needs_to_be_done: Deploy heavy excavators to clear 324 m³ of boulders and reopen a travel lane. Construct a solid 3.5-meter-high concrete-and-stone retaining wall at the bottom of the hill to support the slope permanently, and clean the roadside drains so rainwater flows away without causing more damage.
plain_language_explanation.citizen_safety_advice: Do NOT attempt to walk or drive under the fallen slope. Maintain a safe distance of at least 50 meters and follow all police or local emergency notices until clearance teams give the all-clear.
